name: 64014 · Blue Springs, MO
findings: ZIP 64014 (Blue Springs) has 63 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 64014 (Blue Springs) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
71% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 64014 (Blue Springs) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 84% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
